before.requirement: Render paired || delimiters as a spoiler span when MD_FLAG_SPOILERS is enabled.
before.reason: The before span types contain no spoiler span, and the before collector handles pipes only as table or wiki-link marks.

after.requirement: With MD_FLAG_SPOILERS enabled, render paired || delimiters as an x-spoiler span.
after.reason: For ordinary paragraph text, md_html forwards the input-derived flag to the parser. The parser collects and pairs double-pipe marks, dispatches spoiler span callbacks, and the HTML renderer emits both tags. The harness imposes no flag mask or output check.

source_evidence.quote:
#define MD_FLAG_HARD_SOFT_BREAKS            0x8000  /* Force all soft breaks to act as hard breaks. */
#define MD_FLAG_SPOILERS                    0x10000 /* Enable ||hidden text|| spoiler spans. */

claims.reason: The frozen spoiler behavior was unavailable before the change and has a valid route through the same old harness afterward.
